text: APPROVE. The extractions (`PackageDirsByName`, `WorkspaceDependencies`, `ChangeFilterSite`) are verbatim moves, and folding `reported.Add` into a lazy `.Where` preserves the original per-element dedupe order. The removed nested `foreach`/`while`/`if`/`&&` constructs should bring the complexity to about 15 or below. I could not build or measure it here (no repo available), so the new parameter types (`CiChangeFilter`, `TestInvocation`, `JsInventory.Inventory`, `List<string> missed`) are unchecked and are the main residual risk.
